sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and project path
sections.what: Adds the project's parent folder to the import path, then brings in the database session, the ingestion service and the document type.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the script import backend modules when run from the scripts folder.
sections.watch_out: The package-style imports may fail when the script runs from inside the backend container, depending on its working folder.

sections.name: load_b2b_questions
sections.title: Load B2B question bank
sections.what: Reads the B2B sample text, stores it with a title, description, priority, use cases, audiences, categories and topics, then prints the new ID.
sections.why: Likely reason: sample content for business surveys.
sections.watch_out: The file path is relative to the current folder, and the session is not closed if an error happens first.

sections.name: load_b2c_questions
sections.title: Load B2C question bank
sections.what: Reads the consumer sample text, stores it with its metadata, then prints the new ID.
sections.why: Likely reason: sample content for consumer surveys.
sections.watch_out: Same relative path and session risks as the B2B loader.

sections.name: entry point
sections.title: Run both loaders
sections.what: When run directly, loads the B2B bank, then the B2C bank, then prints a success line.
sections.why: Likely reason: one command sets up both samples.

summary: A script that loads the two sample question banks, one for business and one for consumer surveys, into the document library.
purpose: Gives a new install example content to work with.
why: Likely reason: an empty library gives poor results, so sample data helps a new user start.
how: Adds the project folder to the import path, then for each bank reads its text file, sends it to the ingestion service with metadata and prints the new ID.
inputs: Two text files in the data folder, read relative to the current folder.
outputs: Stored documents and printed confirmation lines.
risks: Running it twice adds duplicate documents. The file paths depend on the folder the script runs from. Sessions are closed only on success.
debug: If a file is not found, run the script from the project root. If import errors appear, check the folder layout. If documents are duplicated, clear the table before rerunning.
